title: Orientation
description: auto lays the drum out as one row when the page is at least twice as wide as tall, otherwise as a column (drum on top, counts and alternation below). The layout re-flows to whatever size the page is given: short rows put everything on one line, and narrow rows drop keys per second, then alternation.

title: Alignment
description: Which side of the page the drum sits on. Right mirrors the row (drum at the right end), for placing the overlay on the right of the screen; centre centres it in a box wider than it needs.

title: Motion
description: full = a released drum zone fades out (it goes dark at once above 15 keys per second), the hand split eases, the drum fades in and out with play. reduced = the hand split and the fade in/out still ease; released zones go dark at once. off = everything instant.

title: Backing
description: scrim = a dark field with soft edges that keeps small text readable on bright maps. panel = a solid graphite panel. none = text straight on the game with a contrast shadow; only for a dimmed background.

title: Keys per second
description: Live and peak keys per second (the same number as key-counter and kps-graph).
